notes.title: Oktoberfest-Update
notes.content:
[h1]Small Update with some Bugfixes and the Oktoberfestmeleon: [/h1]

- Get your Oktoberfest-Meleon 2023 Edition! (Just for a short time)
- Darkmode is back!
- small improvements in the Code
- switch off the visibility of Boxes and Tags ingame
- some Meleons will not drop anymore from now on

notes.title: Small Update Septembre 2023
notes.content:
What is new?
- A new Meleon for your collection
- Bug fixes (Honeymeleon and Goldenmeleon dont do moonwalks anymore, some improvements on the basecode)
- Some added player made pictures
- A feature to toggle the spawning of useless Meleons (Thanks for the idea, DimkaKMS)

notes.title: NEW UPDATE • NEW CONTENT • NEW STEAM ITEMS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/35777720aa5b624b2a7df5c5b5aee238e2611b9b.png[/img]

[h1]We are happy to announce [b]Wall Paint Update![/b][/h1]

[h2]It was a long break but we are back again with some new content![/h2]
[b]If you scroll to the left (Using A/D on keyboard), you will see the Painter-Meleon, who will be very happy to trade with you![/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/e356df96d6d280a5153f2c236ee51b41994fdb6a.png[/img]
[b]From now on, you can trade your 100 common paint for a Paint Roller![/b] There are 16 Paint Rollers added! (So 16 new [b]Steam Items)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/ef17a297e4d4994942bcc0bfa6f32f49dafc442f.png[/img]

[b]If you have 100 common paint (or more), just simply click on one of these buttons.
For example: if you have 100 red common paint, click on the button with red can.
It will REMOVE your 100 red common paint and give you the red paint roller instead![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/0480c7504a2d576423410f98da89702a56a84dc1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/74bcf80b1f0e55d269b4e1e41625e92b356c9a45.png[/img]
If you want to change your Wall Color, just click on the Paint Roller.

There is also Maid-Meleon that will help you clean up the studio!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/6d1833a98db7c69750ac1a71678a2fcee21892d6.png[/img]

[b]There is -45% Sale on Colormeleons!
It will last until September 30[/b]

notes.title: Halloween in the studio!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/b64b0c068ea6483668fd07178e9ea2f7c0f98ee0.jpg[/img]
[b]Welcome everyone[/b] to this [b]special moment[/b], where everything is [b]sweet[/b] and [b]spooky![/b]

What we added for [b]Halloween?[/b]
Everything! (not really, our graphic still doesn't drew lemon tree)

[h1][b]Lets begin with a new event![/b][/h1]
[b]It was a scary night when all your meleons was taken away in the void![/b]
[b]They are under attack by skeleton-meleons RIGHT NOW! Will you protect them before they gone?[/b]

[h1][b]How to play:[/b][/h1]
-Come to the void (find crack on the wall, and start break it! [click on it multiple times])
-Your meleons are in middle. Skeleton-meleons will came from right (from time to time)! You have to kill they before they scare your meleons! Scare meleons are not good meleons! They will run to left, where is big skeleton-meleon wich is changing normal meleons to zombie-meleons!
No one wants zombie-meleons!
Just look at him! He is ugly!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/857f288762756c364dd6d16b96918e00bae44417.png[/img]
(Made by Yojka)

-If you survive 2 hours, you will get the best item in game! A bell! (you can wake up [b]ALL MELEONS[/b] at the same time!)

[h1][b]A gift from us![/b][/h1]
[b]We know why you likes this game so more.[/b]
[b]Because of meleons and bugs.[/b]
[b]soooo....[/b]
[b]We made a flying meleon for everyone! (We hope this will bug game a lot!)[/b]
[i][u][b]Witch-meleon![/b][/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/13006a65a94676e4998472c47e34738d1fc04bd3.png[/img]
(please click on him to be sure you will get him forever!)


[b]Studio is decorated with pumpkins and fake bats! And they are interactive! Just click on them!
Also you can find candy boxes (trick or treat) in the studio! You will get candies (as a steam item) if you brake it![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36380559/a76ab84aa0604d646d57bc19bdeff74c96b67a45.png[/img]

[h2][b]HAPPY HALLOWEEN! (kids)[/b][/h2]
